_doc: T-730/T-738: the ONE authored map file — zone frames (map framing rects, NOT a copy of regions.json: a map zone is a presentation unit, e.g. Highkeep city inside the wold region) plus the landmark entries no existing data file carries (hubs + dungeon surface entrances, with the one-line hover descriptions). Everything else on the maps is DERIVED: flight points from flight_nodes.json, landmark POIs from discovery_nodes.json, quest !/? + gather nodes + party members from live feeds. zonegen --check validates presence + containment of this file. rect = [min_x, min_z, size_x, size_z] in world ground coords (planar y == ground z).

zones.name: The Heartwold
zones.desc: The green vale of the first era — Elmsvale, the King's Road, and the wilds between.

zones.name: Highkeep
zones.desc: The walled capital of the Wold — keep, streets, and the roost above the gate.

zones.name: Ashmoor
zones.desc: The gaslit second-era city beyond the rift — soot, canals, and two ledgers for every account.

zones.name: Greyrise Reach
zones.desc: The third-era arrival district, grown around the Old Keep's bones.

landmarks.name: Elmsvale Village
